review.tagline: 12-week, 24-lesson AI curriculum with PyTorch and TensorFlow notebooks
review.summary: A Microsoft course that teaches AI from symbolic and expert systems through neural networks, computer vision, NLP, genetic algorithms, reinforcement learning, multi-agent systems and ethics. Lessons pair text with Jupyter notebooks in PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras, and several have labs. Translations into 50+ languages are generated by a GitHub Action.
review.audience: Beginners learning AI fundamentals with hands-on Python notebooks
strengths: Covers symbolic AI, deep learning, vision, NLP, RL and ethics in one ordered path
Most lessons have both PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras notebooks
Labs for many lessons, plus a Binder badge to run notebooks in the browser
weaknesses: NLP stops at transformers/BERT and GPT basics; README admits it lags the state of the art
Excludes classic ML, cloud services and deep math; it points to other courses
Not every lesson has a lab; some notebooks are TensorFlow-only or PyTorch-only
Translations inflate clone size; sparse checkout is needed to skip them
needs: Needs Jupyter, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV
